'''2009 Bespin Regionals Garrett Larson DS Kessel''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Garrett Larson]] at [[2009 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Kessel (Dark)|Premiere-D-kessel.gif|label=Kessel}}
* '''Deck name:''' You never go ass to mouth
* '''Username:''' deadbody
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
